setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Looks Like Rain** (3 reviews): Garcia plays pedal steel on this poignant rendition of the song; Described as one of the best versions, characterized as tender and strong [7][8][12]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Thirty-one minute Dark Star leading into Mind Left Body Jam is a highlight; Intense performance caused the listener to speed and grip the wheel tightly [5][10]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Smokin' version of Cumberland Blues is highlighted in the first set [9]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Jam from Dark Star unexpectedly resolves into a rollicking Sugar Magnolia [6]
- **Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks)** (1 review): Dark Star into Sugar Magnolia into Caution is cited as astounding music [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-04-08.sbd.miller.83714.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 170 min; rated 4.55/5 by 11 [1]
- **gd72-04-08.sbd.giles-jeffm.2534.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 170 min; rated 4.36/5 by 33 [2]. Said about its sound: Slight buzzing in keys at start, but audio quality improves after two minutes [5]
- **gd1972-04-08.sbd.hamilton.2185.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 164 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1972-04-08.sbd.pset2.koucky.83143.flac16**: soundboard; 5 songs; 60 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Pigpen sings Who Do You Love during the Caution segment [1]
- Performance is more focused than most later dates of that specific tour [7]
- Musically and sonically resembles the classic Europe '72 album recordings [11]
- Preferred slightly less than the April 14 show, but still a knockout [12]
- Cumberland Blues was missing, so the Europe '72 version was used instead [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-04-08.sbd.miller.83714.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> (16 Track) Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [1]. Also: Steve Rolfe provided the DAT source for this specific transfer [1]
- **gd72-04-08.sbd.giles-jeffm.2534.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> MR (16 track)> DAT> [Disc 3 only: SS]> Sound Forge 4.5>CDR [2]
- **gd1972-04-08.sbd.hamilton.2185.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by G. Hamilton; source: SBD > Master Reel [3]
- **gd1972-04-08.sbd.pset2.koucky.83143.flac16**: transferred by Transfers, Remastering February 24, 2007 by Bill Koucky; source: SBD Reels > DAT ? [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.pandcmusic.co.uk: [Wembley Empire Pool, London, England 4/8/72 (Live) – P&C Music](https://www.pandcmusic.co.uk/product/wembley-empire-pool-london-england-4-8-72-live/) [18]
- Fan art by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Wembley Empire Pool, London, England 4/8/72 Live - RSD 2022 UK Vinyl box set](https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-wembley-empire-pool-london-england-4-8-72-live-rsd-2022-uk-vinyl-box-set-r1529117-790518) [19]
